newsitem.title: USA: CPC 1996 earnings gains to be slowed.
newsitem.headline: CPC 1996 earnings gains to be slowed.

text.p: CPC International Inc said Wednesday its expected earnings gains for 1996, based on strong performance in its consumer foods operations, will be slowed by the impact of corn costs in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company said it had "a very tough year" in its corn refining business, due to extraordinarily high and unpredictable corn costs.
Even though corn refining is only about 15 percent of CPC's overall business, it is having an important effect on results, the company said.

The sudden decline in the corn market carries a probable fourth quarter effect of $0.05 per share compared with the company's thinking when it issued its third-quarter earnings release three weeks ago, the company said.
